data.narrative:
Neko Health, a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne, has raised $326M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 private-stage equivalents in Biotech & Health (Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit) and 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses $700M as a proxy base (derived from total capital raised) and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median anchoring across the 3 same-sector, same-stage private comps yields $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue. The public sector shows a 5.5x median price-to-sales multiple across the three tickers but remains uninformative without target financials.

The two applicable methods support a triangulated range of $1.0B (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.5B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around where Neko Health sits within the peer distribution—particularly the outsized $10.3B valuation of Colossal Biosciences. Narrowing this range would require clarity on revenue trajectory, clinical-stage progress, and capital efficiency relative to named peers.
